title: AISanalyze: User guide
text: AISanalyze provides workflow analyse Automatic Identification System (AIS) data, including: estimating vessel travel distance, time speed; correcting GPS errors delays; identifying AIS stations aircraft; interpolating vessel positions; extracting vessels around target locations; estimating vessel characteristics. vignette illustrates typical workflow.

title: AISanalyze: User guide
text: Convert timestamps Unix time.
code: data("ais") data("point_to_extract") ais$timestamp <- as.numeric(lubridate::ymd_hms(ais$datetime)) point_to_extract$timestamp <- as.numeric(lubridate::ymd_hm(point_to_extract$datetime))

title: AISanalyze: User guide
text: Three variables added: distance_travelled time_travelled speed_kmh
code: ais <- AIStravel(ais_data = ais)

title: AISanalyze: User guide
text: Two logical variables added: station high_speed
code: ais <- AISidentify_stations_aircraft(ais_data = ais)

title: AISanalyze: User guide
text: step corrects unrealistic speeds caused GPS errors transmission delays.
code: ais <- AIScorrect_speed(ais_data = ais)

title: AISanalyze: User guide
text: example interpolates vessel positions every 60 seconds. Alternatively, interpolation can performed exact timestamps. Target locations search radius (m) can specified limit interpolation area interest reduce computation time. datetime column can updated new timestamp. datetime column can updated interpolated timestamps:
code: ais_interpolated_60sec <- AISinterpolate(   ais_data = ais,   type_interpolation = "maximum_time_interval",   maximum_gap_seconds = 60 ) ais_interpolated_exact_timestamps <- AISinterpolate(   ais_data = ais,   type_interpolation = "exact_timestamp",   exact_timestamp = list(     timestamp_to_interpolate = point_to_extract$timestamp,     locations_of_interest = point_to_extract[c("lon", "lat")],     radius = 200000   ) ) ais_interpolated_60sec$datetime <- lubridate::as_datetime(ais_interpolated_60sec$timestamp)  ais_interpolated_exact_timestamps$datetime <- lubridate::as_datetime(ais_interpolated_exact_timestamps$timestamp)

title: AISanalyze: User guide
text: Extract vessel positions within 50 km ±5 minutes target locations timestamps (point_to_extract). Set return_all_vessel_locations = FALSE return vessel position target timestamps: Alternatively, can pass centroids square grid data set search_shape = "square" extract vessel positions within square grid cells:
code: AISextract(   ais_data = ais_interpolated_60sec,   data = point_to_extract,   return_all_vessel_locations = TRUE,   search_into_radius_m = 50000,   interval_time_before = 300,   interval_time_after = 300 ) AISextract(   ais_data = ais_interpolated_exact_timestamps,   data = point_to_extract,   return_all_vessel_locations = FALSE,   search_into_radius_m = 50000,   interval_time_before = 300,   interval_time_after = 300 ) AISextract(   ais_data = ais_interpolated_exact_timestamps,   data = point_to_extract,   return_all_vessel_locations = FALSE, # or TRUE   search_into_radius_m = 50000,   search_shape = "square",   interval_time_before = 300,   interval_time_after = 300 )

title: AISanalyze: User guide
text: function estimates likely vessel characteristics MMSI, including ship type, dimensions, draught, IMO number, name. summary_values summarises values found AIS data, whereas estimated_values contains estimated characteristic vessel.
code: infos <- AISinfos(ais)  summary_values <- infos$summary estimated_values <- infos$estimated_values

what: Correct GPS errors in AIS tracks — AIScorrect_speed
title: Correct GPS errors in AIS tracks — AIScorrect_speed
text: Detects corrects GPS errors delayed AIS messages generate unrealistic vessel speeds, travelled distances, travel times. Note: consecutive GPS errors, first point removed avoid overcorrection.

title: Correct GPS errors in AIS tracks — AIScorrect_speed
code: AIScorrect_speed(   ais_data,   crs_meters = 3035,   threshold_speed_to_correct = 100,   threshold_speed_to_correct_expr = function(speed_kmh) {      return(15 +     stats::median(speed_kmh[speed_kmh > 1], na.rm = TRUE) + 5 *     stats::sd(speed_kmh[speed_kmh > 1 & speed_kmh < stats::quantile(speed_kmh[speed_kmh >     1], 0.75)]))  },   nb_cores = 1,   outfile = tempfile() )

title: Correct GPS errors in AIS tracks — AIScorrect_speed
text: ais_data AIS data frame containing timestamp, lon, lat, mmsi. timestamp must Unix time (seconds since 1970-01-01), lon lat must numeric. Another vessel identifier may used column named mmsi. crs_meters CRS (metres) used calculate travelled distances. Defaults EPSG:3035. threshold_speed_to_correct Speed threshold (km/h) observations corrected. threshold_speed_to_correct_expr Function returning vessel-specific speed threshold speed_kmh. nb_cores Number CPU cores used. outfile File used save logs.

title: Correct GPS errors in AIS tracks — AIScorrect_speed
text: input data corrected travel metrics following columns: speed_kmh_corrected: Whether speed corrected. time_travelled: Travel time (s). distance_travelled: Travelled distance (m). speed_kmh: Vessel speed (km/h).

title: Correct GPS errors in AIS tracks — AIScorrect_speed
code: library(AISanalyze) data("ais")  # Define the Unix time (seconds since 1970-01-01) ais$timestamp <- as.numeric(lubridate::ymd_hms(ais$datetime))  # calculate the travelled distance, time, and speed: ais <- AIStravel(ais_data = ais)  # Correct speed: out <- AIScorrect_speed(ais_data = ais,                  crs_meters = 3035,                  threshold_speed_to_correct = 100)

title: Extract AIS positions around target locations and times — AISextract
code: library(AISanalyze) data("ais") data("point_to_extract")  # Define the Unix time (seconds since 1970-01-01) point_to_extract$timestamp <- as.numeric(lubridate::ymd_hm(point_to_extract$datetime)) ais$timestamp <- as.numeric(lubridate::ymd_hms(ais$datetime))  # calculate the travelled distance, time, speed, and interpolate AIS data: ais <- ais |>   AIStravel() |>   AISinterpolate(type_interpolation = "exact_timestamp",                  exact_timestamp = list(              timestamp_to_interpolate = point_to_extract$timestamp,              locations_of_interest = data.frame(lon = point_to_extract$lon,                                                 lat = point_to_extract$lat),              radius = 200000),                  crs_meters = 3035)  # Extract all vessel positions within the target time interval and radius: out <- AISextract(ais_data = ais,            data = point_to_extract,            crs_meters = 3035,            return_all_vessel_locations = TRUE,            search_into_radius_m = 50000,            interval_time_before = 5 * 60,            interval_time_after = 5 * 60) #>  #> The columns 'datetime, lon, lat' in the AIS data have been renamed to 'ais_datetime, ais_lon, ais_lat'  # Extract each vessel position at the target timestamps within the radius: out <- AISextract(ais_data = ais,            data = point_to_extract,            crs_meters = 3035,            return_all_vessel_locations = FALSE,            search_into_radius_m = 50000,            interval_time_before = 5 * 60,            interval_time_after = 5 * 60) #>  #> The columns 'datetime, lon, lat' in the AIS data have been renamed to 'ais_datetime, ais_lon, ais_lat'
